svg.title: turn_to() on Leg 1
svg.desc: A step-through animation of the real turn_to() on Leg 1 of the delivery run, seen from above on a 4 by 4 grid. The robot starts at (0, 0) facing North. To face East it makes one clockwise quarter turn, heading 0 to 1, and drives to (1, 0). Already facing East, it makes no turn and drives to (2, 0). To face North it makes three clockwise quarter turns, East to South, South to West, West to North, heading 1 to 2, 2 to 3, and 3 wraps to 0, then drives to (2, 1). Already facing North, it drives to (2, 2) and (2, 3) with no turns. Beside it, the turn_to() loop with the running line highlighted and a box showing the heading after each turn.
